classificationReason: Descriptive concordance of PF Net, Net Expectancy R and Win Rate; not statistical significance
methodology: Independent theoretical observations, potentially correlated with executed trades. Closed/completed outcomes only; periods by signal date. Net R denominator = initial price risk × quantity. Winner/loser R are NET R. No shadow portfolio CAGR or equity curve. Competition lists are pending entry candidates, including candidates subsequently rejected for other reasons. Aggregate open risk = sum of initial price risks, excluding costs. Invested capital = gross market value at decision open.
